title: Verify Office can create and edit a customer
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Office role. (this role has Customers: View/Create and Edit/Delete).
steps:
1. Click Customers in the main navigation.
2. Click to add a new customer, fill in the customer name, and save.
3. Open the customer, change a field, and save.
expected: The customer is created and the edit saves successfully.
